modal.openTooltip: Save and open the details note
modal.deleteDetailsMessage: The note "{name}" will be moved to trash when you save the task.
error.notAFile: {path} exists but is not a file
error.detailsReserved: "{name}" is reserved for the task list
settings.languageDesc: Language of the plugin interface. The command name in the command palette changes after restarting Obsidian.
settings.boardNameDesc: Shown in the left ribbon tooltip and on the board tab. Leave empty for the default name.
settings.boardIconDesc: Icon in the left ribbon and on the board tab. Start typing to search icons (lucide.dev names work).
settings.storageDesc: Where the task list and details notes are kept. Changing these only switches the board to another file; existing files are not moved. A missing file is created.
settings.taskFolderDesc: Vault folder for the task file and new details notes. Empty means the vault root.
settings.taskFileDesc: Name of the note with the task list, without .md.
settings.columnsDesc: Each column is a section in the task file. Deleting a column moves its tasks to the first remaining column. "{remove}" is always present and cannot be changed.
settings.columnDragDesc: Reorder columns by dragging their headers.
settings.removeZoneDesc: Hiding the zone does not delete anything: the "{remove}" section stays in the task file with all its tasks.
settings.collapsibleTooltip: Show the arrow that collapses this column
settings.taskCountTooltip: Show the number of tasks next to the title
settings.prioritiesDesc: Shown as a symbol before the task text and written to the task file as [Priority: Name]. The first priority is the default: it has no tag and cannot be deleted. Deleting a priority makes its tasks default.
settings.defaultPriority: Default — not written to the task file
settings.detailsDesc: A task can have a details note in the task folder, linked as [Details: [[Name]]].
settings.detailsFromText: Task text is the details file name
settings.detailsFromTextDesc: On: the note is named after the task text; editing the text renames the note and renaming the note changes the text. Off: the note name is set separately in the task dialog.
settings.detailsByDefaultDesc: New tasks start with details added; you can still remove them in the task dialog before saving.
settings.showDetailsIconDesc: Clicking the icon opens the details note.
